result.description:
## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Lead enterprise architecture and governance for a major ERP transformation program within a federal government   Your new company     Join a major federal government organisation delivering a significant enterprise transformation programme. As part of a large and complex ICT environment, you will play a key role in shaping the future technology landscape, ensuring enterprise platforms, integrations, security controls, and business processes align with strategic objectives. This is an opportunity to work on a high-profile ERP programme that will have a lasting impact across the organisation.      Your new role     As an Enterprise Architect (EL2 equivalent), you will provide architecture leadership, governance, and assurance across a major ERP transformation initiative. Working closely with business stakeholders, cybersecurity teams, vendors, implementation partners, and technical leaders, you will ensure enterprise solutions align with strategic architecture principles and organisational goals. 
 You will develop and maintain enterprise architecture artefacts, provide oversight of integration and data architecture, support identity and access management design, and review solution architectures to ensure alignment with enterprise standards. You will also provide architecture advice to governance forums, identify risks and dependencies, and contribute to strategic decision-making throughout the programme life cycle. 
 This role is ideal for an experienced Enterprise Architect with a strong background in ERP programmes, integration architecture, cloud technologies, and enterprise governance. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated experience delivering Enterprise Architecture services within large and complex environments 
 Strong ERP transformation experience, including architecture governance and design assurance 
 Experience across integration architecture, APIs, middleware, identity management, and data architecture 
 Knowledge of cloud solutions, cybersecurity frameworks, and enterprise architecture principles 
 Experience reviewing and assuring vendor and implementation partner designs 
 Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills 
 Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, or similar enterprise platforms is highly desirable 
 Ability to develop architectural artefacts, transition-state roadmaps, and governance documentation 
 Australian Citizenship with the ability to obtain NV1 Security Clearance 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Initial 6-month contract with 2 x 6-month extension options 
 Opportunity to work on a major enterprise-wide ERP transformation programme 
 Hybrid working arrangements with ACT location 
 Exposure to modern cloud, integration, cybersecurity, and enterprise architecture initiatives 
 High-profile role engaging with senior executives, architecture boards, and implementation partners 
 Collaborative environment with significant strategic influence 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call me now on 02 6112 7695 or email Aanchal.Dwivedi@hays.com.au. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact me for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

If your client gave you free-range to pick your tech stack, what would you do with it? What would you do if you had a new challenge every day? How would you feel if you could impact people's lives through tech?

Established over eighteen years ago, we are a growing Melbourne-based Software Consultancy with a core focus of delivering business-critical digital products to our clients. Our teams work alongside our customers to dissect their complex problems and convert them into value-driven solutions, combining innovative principles in development, design, analysis and quality automation. We utilise Design Thinking and Agile practices to rapidly create customer and business first software, testing and embracing new technologies and trends along the way.

Our Consultants become trusted advisors to our clients, working alongside other client stakeholders to ensure delivery and technical excellence. As a Fabric Consultant, you will lead by example and work hands-on alongside your teammates on delivery - as well as providing high-level guidance and advice to our customers.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer at Fabric:

-Work under autonomy with a self-driven attitude to own problems and deliver solutions
-Understand the complex business and technical problems, learn quickly, understand tradeoffs and communicate a solution
-Capability to research alternative solutions and propose them within given constraints
-Apply different languages and technologies to your projects while coding side by side with other developers on your team
-Implementing continuous delivery practices to accelerate the delivery of new valuable functionality to its intended users
-Applying test-driven development practices to ensure high quality of the software, and reduce future effort and cost on implementing changes to the product
-Mentoring and coaching less experienced mobile engineers in Fabric family and in our clients’ tech teams, hosting tech meetups and our community events to share your expertise with others
-Advising our clients on the right technical decisions and advocating for the right practices to use
-Being an ambassador for Fabric, promoting our values and the practices we use to make sure we build the software right
-Participate in interviewing and recruitment based on business needs
-Generate thought leadership content relevant to your role to support our marketing department in social media activities and meetups
-Write maintainable, efficient, and scalable code, rigorously adhering to Android coding standards and best practice
-Optimize existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies
-Take full ownership of assigned projects or components, proactively identifying areas for improvement and leading technical discussions to enhance solutions
-Provide guidance to junior engineers, sharing expertise to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
-Participate actively in architectural and design decisions, demonstrating a strong grasp of software design principles and scalability
-Seek out growth opportunities to deepen technical expertise and keep the team informed of emerging best practices

The skills you would need to be a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer:
??
Minimum Qualifications:

-7+ years of hands-on experience in Mobile Software Engineering, focusing on scalable architecture and development
-Proficiency in developing for the Android Platform and frameworks relevant to the role
-Experience in the complete Android Development lifecycle, from design, testing, signing, releasing, fixing and beyond
-Understanding of Android’s design principles and interface guidelines
-Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams.
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
-Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
-Strong ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your key benefits of being a part of the Fabric team:

-A variety of business domains to dive into including retail, finance, construction and logistics
-Creating innovative custom products to solve complex problems that existing solutions just can’t
-Collaborating with a team of top notch professionals who are obsessed with value, latest tech and the right way to build a digital product
-Ability to switch projects every 6-12 months to keep you challenged, excited and growing
-Strong support network from the delivery community of practice, leadership and our tech teams to help you address any client challenges you may face
-Very diverse and inclusive environment where people value feedback, connections and collaboration in a workspace
-Great office in CBD with all the amenities (yet you’re welcome to work remotely on most days!), fun team events, lunches and celebrations
